strings: r_c0 listens to m_c's heart, which rapidly pounds even at rest.
Everytime m_c stands up too quickly, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/feel/feels} like {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} heart is going to burst.
m_c can feel {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} blood pool in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} paws whenever {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/stand/stands} up after resting.
